products.product_name: Posse Vegan Leather Accent Chair by Modway
products.product_description: Welcome rich luxury and glam deco style to your living space with the Posse Vegan Leather Accent Chair. A striking addition to the living room, office, bedroom, or entryway, this armchair sits atop a matte black stainless steel sled base complete with squared edges and angular detail. Covered in smooth vegan leather, this upholstered armchair features dense foam padding over no-sag springs for a premium seating experience abounding in comfort and support. This vegan leather chair is perfect for offices looking to impress new clients and for anyone intrigued by retro modern designs that develop space and form in an innovative way. Includes non-marking foot pins. Assembly Not Required. Weight Capacity: 300 lbs.

The Restore Sectional Sofa appeals to minimalist elegance with a crisp design and broad lines accented with French piping details and vegan leather upholstery. Dense foam padding and a pocket coil spring system in the cushions offer a luxe seating experience for your living room and lounge. The Restore Living Room Sectional Sofa is solidly constructed from plywood and wood with non-marking foot caps to protect flooring and connectors between modular pieces. Each Piece Weight Capacity: 440 lbs.
